conflicts.title: SRS algorithm: FSRS-6 (specced) vs SM-2 (shipped)

sideA.statement: The scheduler must be FSRS-6 because retrievability is the only defensible mastery number (~20-30% fewer reviews than SM-2).
sideA.source: CONTENT-GENERATION-PIPELINE-SPEC C30 / EALCH-MASTER c15 / THEME-CATALOGUE C05 / contentresearch c36

sideB.statement: A working SM-2-shaped scheduler already exists and drives due counts, weak spots and Smart Review honestly.

conflicts.code_says: progress.logic.ts:301-350 applyGrade is an SM-2 ease-factor ladder (MIN_EASE 1.3, MAX_EASE 3.0, 1->3->interval x ease); no FSRS and no retrievability probability. SM-2 cannot compute the 0.90-retention figure other docs assume.
conflicts.recommendation: Reframe every doc that asserts FSRS as-built to say 'SM-2 today, FSRS-6 as a later upgrade'; keep SM-2 for launch (adequate at 17-item scale) and gate the FSRS migration behind a real need, since the mastery/headline claims (CF-03) depend on it.
conflicts.rationale: SM-2 is shipped, tested and honest; FSRS is a genuine efficiency and mastery-honesty upgrade but non-blocking. Docs currently advertise an algorithm the code does not run, which will misdirect anyone building against 'the scheduler'.
conflicts.value_if_dropped: If FSRS is dropped, the app loses the only algorithm that yields a decaying 'items you can currently recall' number and a probabilistic mastery gate; if SM-2 is dropped prematurely, a working retention loop is rebuilt for marginal gain.

conflicts.title: SRS card key: (user,item,modality) vs (user,item)

sideA.statement: Cards must key on (user, item, modality) so recognise/produce/discriminate are separate memories - the voice-first learning decision.

sideB.statement: One card per item is what ships; the attempt log has no modality dimension.

conflicts.code_says: progress.logic.ts:303-399 srsCards keys purely on itemId; SrsCard and AttemptEntry carry no modality field. Recognition and production collapse into one schedule.
conflicts.recommendation: Decide now whether to add a modality dimension to AttemptEntry/SrsCard before the corpus and attempt log grow, since retrofitting a modality split after users accumulate history is expensive (the doc's stated warning).
conflicts.rationale: A single card collapses 'I know it' and 'I can say it' into one interval, under-drilling production - the exact skill a speaking-first app sells. But adding modality roughly triples review load and needs sibling-gating (see orphan) to stay tolerable.
conflicts.value_if_dropped: Dropping the modality split makes the SRS blind to the recognise/produce gap that is the product's core; keeping it triples day-one review volume without the gating machinery.

conflicts.title: Mastery definition: retention>=0.90 & reps>=3 vs no mastery concept

sideA.statement: Mastery = retention >= 0.90 AND reps >= 3, never a single quiz; 'complete' and 'mastered' must be two separate words.
sideA.source: EALCH-MASTER c22 / THEME-CATALOGUE C06 / contentresearch c48

sideB.statement: The code has no mastery threshold; the closest proxy (itemsPracticed = >=1 correct) means 'met', not 'retained'.

conflicts.code_says: progress.logic.ts computes ratios/reps but defines no mastery constant, and the shipped SM-2 scheduler has no retrievability to compare against 0.90.
conflicts.recommendation: Either encode a concrete two-factor mastery rule the SM-2 engine can actually compute (e.g. reps>=3 AND interval>=N days) or defer the 0.90-retention definition until FSRS lands (CF-01); do not surface 'mastered' anywhere until one is chosen.
conflicts.rationale: An explicit mastery bar keeps progress honest, but the specified 0.90 formula is uncomputable under SM-2, so the definition and the engine must be reconciled before any 'mastered' UI ships.
conflicts.value_if_dropped: Without a mastery definition, den 'learned' counts and any future 'mastered' label conflate coverage with competence, the fabrication the whole honesty pass set out to remove.

sideA.statement: Amend the schema (register on useCases, itemId+per-distractor errorClass on quiz, audio on table/paradigm, new section types) BEFORE the corpus is written - every breaking change is free today.

sideB.statement: The 'amend before authoring' window was skipped: 17 items and 3 lessons are already authored against the unchanged 12-type schema.

conflicts.code_says: schema.ts unchanged (12 section types; useCases {situation,fr,en} no register; quiz {q,opts,correct,why} no itemId/errorClass; table {cols,rows} no audio). seed.json has 17 items - small enough that migration is still cheap but no longer free.
conflicts.recommendation: Land the highest-leverage schema deltas (useCases.register, quiz.itemId, table/audio) now while the corpus is only 17 items, before it grows and each change becomes a data migration plus re-record.
conflicts.rationale: The zero-cost window closed but the low-cost window is still open; delaying makes register-less French use cases and quiz answers that cannot feed the SRS permanent liabilities.
conflicts.value_if_dropped: Deferring the schema amendments turns a cheap 17-item migration into a large one and ships French use cases with no tu/vous and quiz misses that never reach the scheduler.

duplicates.topic: Home is mode-first with mode buckets
duplicates.statement: The home is mode-first, organised as buckets (Den, Flashcards, Voice Flash, Sentences, Role Play, La Dictee, Playlist, Examiner, Smart Review); the theme-spine home is superseded. Code confirms.

duplicates.topic: Pack = first-class theme x level bundle
duplicates.statement: A Pack is a first-class entity = one theme x one level, ~60 mixed items, with id pack.<level>.<theme>, mode_targets, goal, status, provenance; it is not today's Unit and does not exist in code yet.

duplicates.topic: 15 domains / 108 themes machine-readable catalogue
duplicates.statement: Canonical taxonomy is 15 domains and 108 themes (including an Exam Preparation domain) shipped as a machine-readable catalogue with domain/level_range/exam_flag/immig_flag; retire '~100 themes/~14 domains'. Not in code (theme is a free slug).

duplicates.topic: Corpus sizing ~250-300 packs + ~130-150 Den lessons
duplicates.statement: Retire the ~750 figure; canonical basis is ~250-300 theme x level packs plus a separate ~130-150 Den guided-lesson axis, ~60 items per pack. Lives only in planning against a 17-item seed.

duplicates.topic: Provenance columns on every generated row
duplicates.statement: Add provenance (model, prompt_version, generated_by, reviewed_by, source_refs) to every generated Item/Lesson/Scenario/Pack to audit AI-generated content; partly built in ealch-admin content_items, absent from the app schema.

duplicates.topic: Real per-user Entitlement replaces the fake premium boolean
duplicates.statement: Replace the local premium boolean (upgrade() sets premium:true) with a per-user Entitlement (plan, features[], source iap|stripe|paystack, expiry) tied to a real subscription.

duplicates.topic: Audio segment map beyond single audioRef
duplicates.statement: Add a timestamped audio segment map ([{blockId,startMs,endMs,text}]) plus a content-addressed asset key (hash of script+voice+provider+renderVersion) to drive karaoke highlight and pause-at-interaction; only a single nullable audioRef exists.

duplicates.topic: On-device STT is installed, free and offline
duplicates.statement: STT is on-device (expo-speech-recognition, real stt.ts), free and offline, and is an architecture pillar; the 'no STT installed' claim is stale/superseded.

duplicates.topic: Three-layer content load that never blocks or throws
duplicates.statement: Content loads seed.json (bundled) -> AsyncStorage cache -> remote Supabase-Storage manifest/snapshot, verified by sha256, never blocking first paint and never throwing; seed is the zero-config fallback.

duplicates.topic: schema.ts is a zero-runtime-import shared module
duplicates.statement: schema.ts (and progress.logic.ts) hold zero react-native/zustand/AsyncStorage imports so they load under node --test and are shared by app, admin, generator and publish pipeline.

duplicates.topic: Append-only attempt log; SRS cards derived from it
duplicates.statement: Truth is an append-only AttemptLog and SRS cards are a replayable fold over it (multi-device-safe, CRDT-by-construction). Confirmed in progress.logic.ts.

duplicates.topic: Stable immutable IDs fr.<level>.<theme>.<seq> as SRS key
duplicates.statement: Content moved off array-index addressing to stable immutable dotted IDs (fr.a1.cafe.001, sons.03, sons.03.l1) that are the SRS key; the proposed kebab-title slug is superseded but the underlying decision is live.

duplicates.topic: system_prompts RLS leaks prompt IP; restrict to active=true
duplicates.statement: system_prompts RLS is world-readable including inactive rows, so the content-gen master prompt would leak as public IP; tighten to 'for select using (active = true)'. Still unbuilt (world-readable).

duplicates.topic: Native review (Gate H) is the real cost and the mandatory gate
duplicates.statement: Native reviewer sign-off is the bottleneck and real spend (~$3-5k launch), mandatory (100%) for Sons/A1, all exam answer keys/rubrics and cultural claims, with sampling for lower-stakes B1+; AI may draft but never auto-publishes.

duplicates.topic: Exam copyright guardrails
duplicates.statement: Generate only original items in authentic format (never reproduce papers), attach a visible non-affiliation disclaimer (i18n key examDisclaimer, pending Gate D), and tag every exam item with a format_version. None shipped.

duplicates.topic: Deterministic French correctness gates
duplicates.statement: Three fields must not be trusted from an LLM and need non-LLM gates: verb forms via a deterministic conjugator (verbecc/mlconjug3), gender via a gold lexicon (Lefff/Lexique/spaCy), and IPA via Phonemizer/espeak-ng; plus a CEFR classifier for level-fit. None exist in code.

duplicates.topic: >=30% recycled vocab / <=8 new items comprehensible-input rule
duplicates.statement: Each unit must reuse >=30% vocabulary from earlier units and cap new lexical items (<=8/batch), enforced as a deterministic post-filter (token-diff / Token Miss Rate), not just a prompt request.

duplicates.topic: Versioned OTA snapshot with checksum and rollback
duplicates.statement: Publish builds a version-stamped, sha256-checksummed OTA content snapshot pushed to Supabase Storage and picked up by content.ts; versioned and rollback-able. Built via publish-content.ts.

duplicates.topic: Seeded progress fakes deleted; only freeze:1 kept
duplicates.statement: The seeded streak/reviewDue/weekDots (and reviewCleared) were deleted via migration (store now v5), all now derived from the session/attempt logs; only freeze:1 remains as a real day-zero grant, not a measurement.

duplicates.topic: Immigration/Canada-first build order
duplicates.statement: Build B1-B2 content plus the Examiner (TEF Canada, TCF Canada, DELF B2) first as the market wedge; only stub exam cards exist today.

orphans.statement: Sibling gating: a produce card is not created until its recognise sibling reaches stability >= 7 days, so learners are never asked to produce words they cannot yet recognise.
orphans.note: Appears only here; the essential pacing rule that makes the modality split (CF-02) tolerable by preventing a day-one review explosion. Worth reviving alongside any modality work.

orphans.statement: Weak-spot detection should rank by Wilson lower confidence bound with MIN_ATTEMPTS=8 over a 30-day window, not raw counts over 7 days.
orphans.note: Only source. The shipped topWeaknesses ranks by raw count over 7 days; the Wilson-bound + min-attempts approach is a cheap statistical hardening that avoids surfacing noise as a 'weakness'.

orphans.statement: Cap the daily review queue (e.g. 20/day) and present a backlog gently ('do 20 today, clear the rest over the week') rather than the raw due count.
orphans.note: Only source; named the single biggest churn event in the SRS category. dueCards()/reviewDueCount() currently return the full backlog uncapped - a high-value returning-user retention fix.

orphans.statement: Cache the shared instruction prefix across generation packs for ~90% input-cost reduction.
orphans.note: Only source. A large, concrete cost lever for bulk generation that should survive into any generation-runner spec.

orphans.statement: Version-hash staleness: a prompt/schema/format change marks only affected items stale by version hash and enqueues just those for regen + re-review, never the whole corpus.
orphans.note: Only source. The optimization that avoids regenerating thousands of items on every prompt tweak; genuinely important once the corpus is large.

orphans.statement: Idempotency-keyed resumable generation runner: queue + workers, key = hash(prompt_version + schema_version + inputs), building on the existing port/publish scripts.
orphans.note: Only source. The orchestration layer that makes bulk regen cheap and safe; the port/publish scripts exist as anchors but the runner does not.

orphans.statement: Affiliate/immigration lead-gen as a 5-15% revenue top-up (italki/Preply tutoring, recurring course affiliates, TEF/TCF immigration leads).
orphans.note: Only source. A modest but real supplemental revenue line uniquely fitted to this app's immigration audience; nothing in code or other docs references it.

orphans.statement: Reject Boss Fight (timed cumulative gate); replace with an untimed, advisory, skippable Checkpoint that writes to the SRS and never hard-gates paid content.
orphans.note: Only source. A load-bearing product principle - no hard content gates for paying adults - embodied nowhere in code or other docs.

orphans.statement: Reject XP/levels; the honest headline is 'items you can currently recall' (retrievability >= 0.90 and reps >= 3), a number that goes down with inaction.
orphans.note: Only source. The no-XP stance is honored (no XP shipped) but the proposed honest recall headline needs FSRS (CF-01); a distinctive motivational-honesty idea worth preserving.

orphans.statement: Author error diagnosis on the content: QuizQ needs itemId plus per-distractor Choice.errorClass/why so a wrong answer is diagnosed in O(1) and feeds weak spots/SRS.
orphans.note: Only source at this granularity. Currently only a single lesson-level 'why' exists; per-distractor diagnosis is a zero-runtime-cost, high-leverage error loop.

orphans.statement: Mark French text with fr-FR (accessibilityLanguage/lang on the TX component) so VoiceOver does not read French in the English voice.
orphans.note: Only source. A concrete, cheap accessibility fix (TX has no lang prop) that no other doc raises.

orphans.statement: Teach 'on' at A1 alongside nous, move negation and yes/no + question words into the first third of A1 (they currently arrive at units 18-20 of 26), and add CEFR can_do statements to drive units.
orphans.note: Only source. Concrete curriculum-sequencing fixes: a learner currently cannot ask or deny for two-thirds of A1, and units lack a communicative-function anchor.

orphans.statement: Sub-Item Token/Align on examples enabling story tap-a-word, inline clues and chunk alignment, with a tokensReconstruct hard publish gate.
orphans.note: Only source. Enables tap-a-word comprehensible-input reading; not represented in schema or any other doc.

orphans.statement: Authoring collaboration primitives: autosave, a draft lock to prevent two editors clobbering, and inline threaded per-block comments.
orphans.note: Only source. Draft-lock/comments become necessary once more than one author works the corpus; the studio editor currently saves only on explicit click with no lock.

orphans.statement: Live device preview (phone frame + real renderers incl. Camille narration) with a QR/deep-link to open a draft on device before publish.
orphans.note: Only source. Preview-before-publish catches render errors before they enter the OTA bundle; no equivalent exists and no other doc raises it.

orphans.statement: Restructure-with-migration: attaching/moving a pack to a curriculum node auto-applies domain/theme/level tags and any restructure rewrites tags via a migration with preview + diff + undo.
orphans.note: Only source. Protects published items from silent tag reassignment once a real corpus exists; a genuine data-safety idea.

orphans.statement: Positional deep-link anchors (<lessonId>#s<n>.<k>) derived from array index, invalidated on corpusVersion mismatch and never used as an SRS key, backing the error drawer's 'see this in the lesson' link.
orphans.note: Only source. The mechanism that lets an error point back into the exact lesson block without polluting the immutable SRS key space.

orphans.statement: Skip a Sepia mode: warm LIGHT.card from #FFFFFF to ~#FDFBF6 to capture the sepia delta with a two-hex change and no third theme.
orphans.note: Only source. A tiny, high-return reading-comfort tweak that avoids the cost of a whole third color mode.

coverage.code_areas: Claims reference ealch-v2 (schema.ts, content.ts/content.logic.ts, progress.logic.ts/useProgress.ts, useStore.ts, tts.ts/stt.ts, config.ts/flags.ts, home.tsx/den.tsx/lesson.tsx/placement.tsx/settings.tsx/profile.tsx and other drill screens, seed.json/curriculum.ts/playlists.ts/wordOfDay.ts, supabase functions coach/tts and schema.sql) and ealch-admin (drizzle schema, content actions/BodyEditor/WorkflowCard, publish-content.ts). Reconciliation performed over the supplied claim set and its embedded code evidence; source files were not independently re-read since the data is self-contained by design.
coverage.notes: 235 claims across 21 docs plus pedagogy notes. Dominant tension is target-state specs vs a thin shipped build: ~17 corpus items/3 lessons behind a 43-unit UI, a working SM-2 attempt-log SRS where docs specify FSRS+modality, an entirely unbuilt narration engine and Examiner, and unimplemented monetization. Several 'already exists' framings (7-stage Den, cafe roleplay, exam schema hooks, NativeWind, service fallbacks) are contradicted by code and flagged as conflicts. Many repeated cross-doc decisions (mode-first home, Pack entity, 108-theme catalogue, provenance, entitlements, audio segment map, Gate H review, deterministic French gates) collapsed as duplicates. Per the flag-only rule, all conflict recommendations are advisory and every conflict status is UNRESOLVED; I did not pick winners.
